tickets.description: Washing machine (LG, landlord-supplied) not working: power failure. Tenant offers to replace it with her own machine, which would stay hers.

landlord_decision.conditions: Tenant may fit her own machine; it remains hers and she takes it when she leaves. Landlord pays removal of the old LG up to £30.
landlord_decision.evidence_quote: Yes, she can have her own and take it with her. I'll pay for the old one to go, up to thirty pounds.
